text:
erin: dropped a new "cost-lens" card in staging that aggregates per-chain token burn, model-sku delta, and a "cache-lineage" column showing which prefetch keys contributed savings. preview: https://staging.redwood.internal/dash/cost-lens :mag_right:

vik: cool. does chain-level mean we sum tokens across a sequence of model calls or attribute to the initiating route?

ersam: (typo) sam: we attribute both ways: primary attribution (initiating route) and chain-slice (per-model hop). UI can pivot.

mira: sampling question: are you using full traces or event counters? finance needs reproducible exports for audits.

erin: we use hybrid sampling: 1% full-trace capture + aggregated counters for all requests. every CSV row includes `provenance` (sampled|aggregate|amortized_rollup) and `sample_rate`.

vik: how are shared cache savings handled across chains that fan-out? previous approaches double-counted prefetch hits.

erin: prototype features two modes: naive (direct hits only) and lineage-amortize. lineage-amortize walks the chain within a 10s window and splits credit proportionally by token contribution. heavy keys are capped to top-40 owners; remainder goes to "others".

sam: add a confidence score (0-1) derived from sample_rate and owner-cardinality. UX should surface it as a small badge and an info popover with the math.

mira: performance: lineage-amortize looks expensive. can we precompute nightly rollups and serve near-real-time microbatch for the last 10m?

erin: yes. we precompute nightly for long windows and run a 2m microbatch for near-real-time. UI will state source: nightly|microbatch|sampled.

deploy-bot: deploy 6464646464-cost-lens -> staging succeeded (13s)

vik: API ask: keep response flat for CSVs. include `schema_version`, `explain_inputs` (flattened k=v pairs), and `provenance`. no nested blobs.

erin: done. schema_v=1. explain_inputs includes routing_weights, sample_rate, lineage_window, cap_top_n.

sam: add small runway note for negative amortized values caused by eviction+prefetch overlap and how finance should treat them in reconciliations.

erin: added a runbook link in the card and an exportable CSV column `interpretation_notes`.

mira: gating: hide lineage-amortize behind `cost_lens_lineage_v1`. default off in prod. schedule a 30m review with finance + infra before enabling.

erin: booking 30m. thanks all :thumbsup:
